name: Invoice
description: An incoming (payable) or outgoing (receivable) invoice: lines with VAT, issue and due dates, and the payments that settle it.

global.schema:
type InvoiceState {
  direction: InvoiceDirection!
  number: String
  status: InvoiceStatus!
  counterparty: Party!
  issuedAt: DateTime
  dueAt: DateTime
  currency: String!
  lines: [InvoiceLine!]!
  payments: [Payment!]!
  reference: String
  notes: String
  voidReason: String
}

type Party {
  name: String
  contactId: String
  email: String
  vatId: String
  address: String
}

type InvoiceLine {
  id: OID!
  description: String!
  quantity: Float!
  unitPrice: Float!
  vatRate: Float!
}

type Payment {
  id: OID!
  paidAt: DateTime!
  amount: Float!
  method: PaymentMethod!
  transactionId: String
}

enum InvoiceDirection {
  OUTGOING
  INCOMING
}

enum InvoiceStatus {
  DRAFT
  OPEN
  PAID
  VOID
}

enum PaymentMethod {
  BANK_TRANSFER
  CARD
  CASH
  OTHER
}
global.initialValue: {"direction": "OUTGOING", "number": null, "status": "DRAFT", "counterparty": {"name": null, "contactId": null, "email": null, "vatId": null, "address": null}, "issuedAt": null, "dueAt": null, "currency": "EUR", "lines": [], "payments": [], "reference": null, "notes": null, "voidReason": null}

operations.name: SET_INVOICE_DETAILS
operations.schema:
input SetInvoiceDetailsInput {
  direction: InvoiceDirection
  number: String
  counterpartyName: String
  contactId: String
  email: String
  vatId: String
  address: String
  currency: String
  reference: String
  notes: String
  dueAt: DateTime
}

errors.name: InvoiceClosedError
errors.description: The invoice is paid or void

errors.name: InvoiceIssuedError
errors.description: The field is fixed after issuing

operations.name: ADD_LINE
operations.schema:
input AddLineInput {
  id: OID!
  description: String!
  quantity: Float!
  unitPrice: Float!
  vatRate: Float!
}

errors.name: InvalidLineError
errors.description: The line quantity is not positive

operations.name: UPDATE_LINE
operations.schema:
input UpdateLineInput {
  id: OID!
  description: String
  quantity: Float
  unitPrice: Float
  vatRate: Float
}

errors.name: InvalidLineError
errors.description: The line quantity is not positive

operations.name: REMOVE_LINE
ISSUE_INVOICE
RECORD_PAYMENT
operations.schema:
input RecordPaymentInput {
  id: OID!
  paidAt: DateTime!
  amount: Float!
  method: PaymentMethod!
  transactionId: String
}

errors.name: InvalidPaymentError
errors.description: The payment amount is not positive
